definitions.gloss: cropped back and sides; clipped nape; undercut
definitions.explanation: A haircut in which the hair at the back and sides is clipped very short from the bottom upward, while the top is left longer.

examples.english: I got the back and sides cropped short.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{刈|か}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: A cropped cut is cool in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{刈|か}り{上|あ}げで、⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}め→長め：14550_nagame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}して→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: At the salon I asked them to crop the back short and leave the top on the long side.

notes:
From {刈|か}り{上|あ}げる (to clip upward). The verb form {刈|か}り{上|あ}げる is used too: ⟦{襟足|えりあし}→襟足：18005_eriashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刈|か}り{上|あ}げる (to crop the nape).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ツーブロック{刈|か}り{上|あ}げ: a two-block cut, short sides under longer top hair
- {刈|か}り{上|あ}げ⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧: women with a cropped undercut
- ⟦{襟足|えりあし}→襟足：18005_eriashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刈|か}り{上|あ}げ: a cropped nape

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{坊主頭|ぼうずあたま}→坊主頭：32951_bouzuatama⟧: the whole head clipped close
- ⟦{短髪|たんぱつ}→短髪：32996_tanpatsu⟧: short hair in general
